title: 603 WEST PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY; BOARD FILE NO. 260080
text:
[C. PUBLIC NUISANCE HEARINGS regarding the abatement of vacant buildings or structures that are]
603 WEST PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY; BOARD FILE NO. 260080
  C.D.: 15 (Councilmember Tim McOsker); Wilmington – Harbor City Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Zeydi Stewart
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Code Enforcement/Vacant Building Abatement

  OWNER:  Inchu and Taesuk Mun

  SUBJECT:

  The Department of Building and Safety (LADBS) requests that the Board of Building and
  Safety Commissioners (BBSC) determine that the subject property, a one-story, commercial
  building that is continually breached and left open to unauthorized entry, constitutes a public
  nuisance.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS NOT APPEALABLE.
